high_level_description: The inside of a tidy Mexican pharmacy with a calm woman pharmacist in a white coat at the counter.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Mexico City; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright high-altitude sunlight with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Clean white shelves lined with small plain boxes and bottles behind the counter, and a door to a small doctor's office at the side.

elements.desc: A woman pharmacist of about forty-five with shoulder-length dark hair and an open white coat, standing upright behind the counter, looking straight at the viewer with open eyes and a warm reassuring smile.
A pale counter with a small paper bag and a bottle of rehydration drink.
A glowing green pharmacy cross sign on the wall.
Tall white shelving with neat rows of small coloured boxes.
